reason: Almost all weight is amendments to the law freezing Palestinian Authority funds linked to terror payments (forfeiture of frozen funds, offsets for terror damages, medical costs of attackers, car theft, Gaza transfers) plus bans on transfers to the Authority; all move toward withholding its money, which is what the statement asks. Some amendments go beyond an amount equal to prisoner payments, but they are extensions of the same withholding policy, not a different issue. The two bills on protecting soldiers from Palestinian Authority complaints (11, 13; weight 8) are off-topic and light.
